config.notes: Primary mandate from USER_DIRECTIVES.md: pressure test and prepare release version 0.0.7. pyproject.toml currently declares fhir4ds-v2 version 0.0.6, so the directive target version overrides package metadata and release/package checks must verify version 0.0.7 before final completion. Evolution must run exactly one core QA domain pass for each domain 3-10 from SPEC_QA_DOMAINS.md, mapped as iteration 1 -> domain 3, 2 -> domain 4, 3 -> domain 5, 4 -> domain 6, 5 -> domain 7, 6 -> domain 8, 7 -> domain 9, 8 -> domain 10. Do not advance from a domain iteration while it has unresolved non-terminal CRITICAL, HIGH, or MEDIUM issues; fix and architect-review those issues first. Keep 100% spec compliance. The directive pipeline included benchmarks after docs_audit, but STATE_SCHEMA.md does not define a benchmarks workflow, so benchmarks are preserved here as a required final gate and must be covered by pre_release/docs/scribe reporting rather than as an invalid pipeline step. Release Engineer artifact gate is required because this campaign affects package metadata, native DuckDB extensions, wheel contents, WASM artifacts, public imports, benchmarks, and release behavior.
